metadata.description: SEO + GEO (AI findability) skills backed by the findable-audit CLI

plugins.name: findable-audit
plugins.description: Audit and implement AI-search visibility (GEO) and technical SEO. Three skills: geo-audit runs the findable-audit CLI on a URL and turns the report into a fix plan ordered by the points you are losing; geo-implement generates the indexing artifacts for a static site (robots.txt, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, JSON-LD, sitemap wiring, IndexNow); fix-technical-seo fixes the canonical, redirect, on-page, security-header and accessibility findings.
